intro:
Blast off and let the chaos begin!
Get ready for a red-hot, hilarious summer showdown!
description:
Dive into 10 unique and easy-to-play party games filled with summer fun!
Launch rocket fireworks at your rivals, slip and slide as somen noodles, and swipe fresh-grilled BBQ before anyone else can grab it!

Challenge CPU opponents in single-player, or battle it out with family and friends in a group of up to 4 players!
All 10 games also support online multiplayer, so you can take on players from around the world in head-to-head matches!

[Free Mode]
Pick your favorite game and jump right in!

[Party Mode]
Choose a series of games and play them back-to-back!
Compete for the highest total score to become the champion!

[Online Mode]
Hop into Quick Matches to challenge players from around the world right away!
Create your own room and enjoy matches with friends, no matter the distance!

[Included Minigames]
・Fire! Rocket Fireworks
・Somen Slide
・Float Ring Battlers
・Fan Blast!
・BBQ Grab Battle
・Frozen Treat Tower
・Beetle Battle
・Trick Surfing
・Sandal Toss
・Smack the Mosquitoes!
